## Plugin reference

- Description: Idle blocker `ops`: any op running on the host (build, push, check, test, e2e) keeps it busy — read from the host-wide live-ops markers (flock-probed), an opportunistic op (the idle test batch) excepted. On main, a watch on the live-ops dir asks for a re-evaluation on every op start and end.
- Server:
  - Contributes: `host.idle-blocker` "ops"
- Machine:
  - Register: `defineFileWatcher('host-idle.live-ops')`
